items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I'll tell you another fellow I started off here was Slovakovich.

ctx.x: Oh. Was he good? He developed pretty good.

I don't know, you see I was running all around the country and I understood that he did pretty good. I'll tell you another fellow I started off here was Slovakovich. Oh, thank you, Vodakovich, yeah. I started, I was playing at Tom's Roll-Off. Tom Roll-Off's coming in pretty often the other night even. I was playing at, and Max Fink was a fiddler and so forth. And he asked me one day, he says, girl, if I bring my horn, I bought a horn, if I bring it, he said, would he help me out? I said, sure. Why not? Sure…
I guess you helped quite a few of them, did you know?
